sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 234574 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: USFS: 'Mid-April through late November.' recreation.gov runs a first-come, first-served season in late April (2026: Apr 16-30) and its Peak (reservable) season from May 1 to about Nov 29.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raccoon-branch-campground ('Seasons of Use: Mid-April through late November') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574/rates (rate seasons), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $20 per site per night; electric hook-up +$7 ($27). Senior/Access pass: basic $10, electric $17.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raccoon-branch-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night, Electric hook-up fee: $7 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, STANDARD ELECTRIC 27), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574 ('five campsites have electric hookups') + campsite catalog (the 5 public STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list Electricity Hookup 30 and Water Hookup Yes; no sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 17 public sites (5 electric/water, 12 non-electric) plus 3 host/management sites; all back-in, paved spurs. Max vehicle lengths 20-60 ft, most 25-40.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234574 (17 STANDARD sites, all Driveway Entry Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 20-60; 3 MANAGEMENT sites excluded) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574 ('Every site accommodates RV or tent camping', 'paved roads and spurs'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574 ('flush toilets, drinking water, paved roads and spurs and a dump station. There are no showers') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raccoon-branch-campground ('Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov in the Peak season; 8 of the 17 public sites are not reservable (first-come), and the whole campground is first-come in its late-April opening weeks. Reservations close 4 days before arrival. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon. No cell coverage. $10 cancellation fee.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notices 'Check-in is at 2pm and check-out is at 12pm') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234574/rates ('First-come, First-served Season') + campsite catalog (8 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites reservable: false) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/raccoon-branch-campground ('You may stay up to 14 nights'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'The America the Beautiful Senior and Access Passes provide a 50% discount to the base campsite fee (not hook ups).'

summary: Confirmed $20 / $27 electric on the USFS page and rec.gov, 30-amp electric with water at 5 sites, dump, reservable on rec.gov. Added season mid-April to late November, 17 sites to 60 ft (all back-in), flush toilets/water/no showers, 8 FCFS sites, 14-night max, 4-day cutoff, Senior/Access 50% off base. Booking window left inherited (not stated).
